race.description: Nijinsky Standing At Yirribee Stud Pace
race.comment: ANGELIC ATTITUDE (1) registered a comfortable win last time out, working to the front from a much wider barrier before drawing clear and scoring by 7.4 metres at this venue. can take advantage of the ace draw and go back-to-back. PIRANI PRINCESS (2) draws well and is in the mix off a West Wyalong placing two back. MURPHYS REWARD NZ (3) is aided by a good draw and could be more competitive here. HANCOCKS HERO (5) has been tackling higher-graded races so is better placed and has won at this circuit and distance before.
